note: Rivals (Meitou helper, Rivals.cs): /LWRIVAL_k/ carries rival k's live name; lw_if rival k: 1 a rival about, 2 one that has beaten the squad.

say: /LWRIVAL_0/ came through asking about your squad and wouldn't say why.
Somebody called /LWRIVAL_0/ is buying drinks for anyone who's seen your lot.
/LWRIVAL_0/ was in here two nights ago, telling anyone who'd listen what your squad did to them.
I'd watch the roads if I were you. /LWRIVAL_0/ has been asking which way you went.
/LWRIVAL_0/ sat in that corner for an hour sharpening a blade, muttering your squad's name.
You're the ones /LWRIVAL_0/ keeps asking about, aren't you?
/LWRIVAL_0/ hasn't forgotten you, mind. Thought you should know.
Somebody's looking for your squad. /LWRIVAL_0/, they said.
/LWRIVAL_0/ has been telling everyone how they put your squad in the dirt.
Heard /LWRIVAL_0/ beat your lot. They won't stop going on about it.
/LWRIVAL_0/ walked in here grinning, reckons your squad wasn't so hard after all.
